modeNotes.chimps: CHIMPS disables income and selling, so farms, Merchantmen, Monkey City and Benjamin give nothing. Tiers lean on the Bloons wiki's CHIMPS strategy page: its listed win conditions rank highest, its support picks next.
modeNotes.boss: Boss events reward economy first (Geraldo and Benjamin, BRFs with Overclock), then raw damage and Paragons in later tiers. Each boss counters different things, so check the boss notes before committing.

dangerRounds.title: First MOAB
dangerRounds.threat: The first MOAB of the game.
counters: Ezili's MOAB Hex or Corvus's Ancestral Might

dangerRounds.title: Ceramic waves
dangerRounds.threat: Large waves of Ceramics that test grouped damage.
counters: Wall of Fire (1-2-0) or Dragon's Breath
Glue to hold the wave together

dangerRounds.title: Leads, Fortified MOABs and BFBs
dangerRounds.threat: A mix of Lead bloons, Fortified MOABs and BFBs.

dangerRounds.title: Camo Ceramics
dangerRounds.threat: Camo Ceramic waves: anything without camo detection is wasted.
counters: Camo detection on your carries (Radar Scanner, Ultravision, Ninja)

dangerRounds.title: Camo Regrow Leads + DDTs
dangerRounds.threat: Fortified Camo Regrow Leads and three DDTs.
counters: Towers that pop Camo, Black and Lead

dangerRounds.title: DDT rush
counters: Strong DDT damage not blocked by the Fortified MOABs' insides
Glue Strike / Glue Storm so lead-blocked towers can hurt DDTs

dangerRounds.title: Fortified BFBs and ZOMGs
dangerRounds.threat: The classic run-ender: dense Fortified BFBs and ZOMGs.
counters: MOAB Press (2-0-4) or The Bloon Solver for the Super Ceramic insides
Save MOAB-killing abilities for this round

dangerRounds.title: MOABs and Fortified DDTs
dangerRounds.threat: MOABs plus Fortified DDTs; plan ability cooldowns from R98.
counters: Bloon Sabotage (0-4-0), timed with cooldowns in mind

dangerRounds.title: B.A.D.
dangerRounds.threat: The Big Airship of Doom; its insides spawn ZOMGs and DDTs.
counters: Saved single-target burst: Spike Storm (2-4-0) or First Strike Capability (0-4-0)
First Strike can skip a damaged BAD's insides
Psi and Silas abilities do nothing to the BAD itself

heroSynergies.name: Geraldo
synergies: Rare Quincy Action Figure funds early farms in boss events
Blade Trap handles Bloonarius bleed and skull bloons
Rejuv Potion resets ability cooldowns (watch the heat cost against Blastapopoulos)
Support pairing for Comanche Commander in CHIMPS
heroSynergies.tip: A primary boss-event hero; in CHIMPS he is a support pick rather than a win condition.

heroSynergies.name: Sauda
synergies: Strong early CHIMPS starter, especially on maps with overlapping lanes
Relentless Glue triggers her stun and slow bonus damage
Dragon's Breath triggers her damage-over-time bonus
Leaping Sword is spammable early boss damage in Boss Rush
heroSynergies.tip: She isn't a solo tower: plan the towers that set up her bonus damage before the mid game.

heroSynergies.name: Benjamin
synergies: Early cash snowballs the whole boss-event economy
Place him behind a line-of-sight blocker, or sell him between tiers 1 and 2
Stacks with BRF, Marketplace or Merchantman setups
Avoid in CHIMPS: income is disabled
heroSynergies.tip: Pick him first in boss events; never in CHIMPS.

heroSynergies.name: Psi
synergies: MIB, Embrittlement and Glue Strike let him hit Lead and Purple bloons early
Energizer Subs help him level toward 20
Instakills MOABs at level 14, BFBs at 16, DDTs and ZOMGs at 20
Never targets BADs or Boss Bloons; clashes with Perma-Spike stalling
heroSynergies.tip: Great in CHIMPS, nearly useless in boss events.

heroSynergies.name: Admiral Brickell
synergies: Buffs naval towers: Carrier Flagship and Pirate Lord are CHIMPS win conditions with her
Destroyer and Sub spam against Dreadbloon and Phayze
Sub Commander with Brickell works against Lych
Energizer Subs are a common late pairing
heroSynergies.tip: Only worth it on maps with real water space near the track.

bosses.name: Bloonarius
bosses.note: High health, slow; its threat is the bloons it spawns. Damage releases Bleed bloons, and skulls spawn waves (BADs at later tiers). Mix boss damage with spawn defense; Geraldo's Blade Trap helps.

bosses.name: Lych
bosses.note: Steals most buffs (not Village range) and heals when you sell. Its soul drains lives and it revives MOABs. Keep Overclock, Call to Arms and brews away from it; Elite Defender (2-0-5) can solo it from range.

bosses.name: Vortex
bosses.note: Speeds every bloon up until they reach it. At each skull it is knocked back, shielded, and stuns nearby towers. Use long-range towers, spread defenses along the track and keep exit backup.

bosses.name: Dreadbloon
bosses.note: Cycles immunity through Primary, Military, Magic and Support, so mix tower classes. Constantly spawns Dreadrock bloons and has a Ceramic phase then a Lead phase that reduces incoming damage.

bosses.name: Phayze
bosses.note: Camo, warps ahead after skulls, and jams radar so towers attack about half the time. Use native-camo, long-range towers (Elite Defender, Aircraft Carrier, Plasma Accelerator).

bosses.name: Blastapopoulos
bosses.note: Purple, burns off damage-over-time, and shrinks tower range. Most hits add heat; overheating stuns towers and slows abilities. Ice towers cut heat, and Ice Monkeys and Silas ignore the overheat.

bosses.name: Diamondback
bosses.note: Multi-segment snake: the head cancels pierce, so hit it from the sides or behind where segments bunch up. Breaking the tail shield stuns it; skulls release Diamond Bloon waves, so keep fast or damage-over-time cleanup.
